blocks.text: Welcome to Belize! Upon arrival at Belize International Airport, you will be greeted by a representative holding a sign with your name. You will travel approximately 60 minutes by road to the river dock, followed by a scenic 60-minute riverboat transfer to your jungle lodge. Dinner is included this evening.

blocks.text: Today you will enjoy activities included in your all-inclusive stay. Options include sunrise canoeing, jungle sunrise walks, Maya jungle medicine and village experiences, river safaris, birdwatching excursions, visits to the Lamanai Maya ruins, sunset cocktail cruises, and night wildlife tours. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included.
